plugins.name: zzop
plugins.description: Deterministic repository oracle for AI agents: point it at a repo and get one JSON answer — inventory, dependency graph, per-file risk, and the frontend-call x backend-route join — byte-identical for the same input, with its blind spots named rather than guessed past. Run /plugin install after adding this marketplace; the plugin then fetches its own self-contained binary (5 platforms, no Node) on first session — nothing to put on PATH. That first session does NOT list the zzop tools yet (its tool list was settled before the download finished): restart Claude Code once and they appear. On Windows the download step needs a POSIX shell; Git for Windows supplies one, and a plugin marketplace is a git clone anyway.
